delta_convention: Delta = MSE_NET - MSE_ASYM; positive supports two flows, negative supports one net flow

models.NET: y_{k+1} = y_k + scale*net(concat(context, step_x_k, y_k/scale)); ResidualMLP(din=context+step+1, dout=1); recursive in its own prediction; NOT relu(s)(1-y)-relu(-s)y
models.ASYM: (u,r,stay)=softmax(concat(rate_logits(context, step_x_k), 0)); y_{k+1}=y_k+u(1-y_k)-r*y_k; ResidualMLP(din=context+step, dout=2); rates never read the recursive state

common_training.loss: mean(((prediction-target)/fit_scale)**2) over batch and all horizon steps; full-path BPTT, no detach, no teacher forcing
common_training.clip_sensitivity: np.clip(pred,0,1) scored separately; never fed back into recursion

window.states: exact UTC hourly snapshot y[4h], t-24..t+24

inputs.context: hist y[t-24:t]/scale (24) + past weather hours t-23..t standardized (288) + given future weather hours t+1..t+24 standardized (288) = 600; y0 passed separately
inputs.step_x_k: weather at hour t+k+1 standardized (12) + UTC sin/cos of that hour (2) + weekend of that hour (1) = 15

task_A_us_era5.legality: 49 states observed and finite; weather hours t-23..t+24 finite; county weather not identically zero (missing mapping); identical window list for both models
task_A_us_era5.fit_statistics: train split only: scale = event->county->origin-equal RMS of hist+y0; source_mean = same-weighted mean; weather mean/std per channel over train windows with the same weights
task_A_us_era5.weighting: event -> county -> origin -> lead equal; sampler draws event, then county, then origin uniformly; independent data RNG so paired seeds see identical batches

tuning.select_by: mean over DEV seeds of best event-equal validation path MSE (2022)
tuning.final_updates: median of the selected config best_update over DEV seeds, nearest 250, clamp [250,3000]

task_A_us_era5.uncertainty: paired resampling of evaluation overlap components (event-window time intersection); exact sign-flip over components; per-seed losses aggregated after squaring; descriptive only

task_B_aneel.data: rebuilt_selected_ledgers.npz verified by 192 f64-LE array fingerprints
task_B_aneel.context: 168 dims (24 group one-hot + 24 hist/s + 24x5 known calendar); step calendar 5 dims
task_B_aneel.checkpoint_policy: reuse qualified local repair checkpoints after metadata verification and bitwise replay; one-seed retrain spot check per model
task_B_aneel.evaluation: reused_2019 retrospective; company-equal primary; per company and collection paired Delta; 168h common-calendar block sensitivity; mean-company-relative gain and ratio-of-means kept separate

task_C_synthetic.rng: numpy SeedSequence(entropy=seed, spawn_key=(stage, scene, law, gamma_flag, split)); training pool of 512 per scene, n uses its prefix
task_C_synthetic.fit_statistics: scale = RMS of training target states of that environment; source_mean = their mean

tuning.environment: law index 1 (target sd .020), n=128, gamma=.04, three scenes mixed
tuning.select_by: mean over DEV seeds of best scene-equal validation path MSE against realized events

task_C_synthetic.final_grid: 3 laws x 3 n x 5 seeds x 2 models = 90 fits; gamma=0, n=128, 3 laws x 5 seeds x 2 models = 30 control fits
task_C_synthetic.computation_note: every event in a scene has identical inputs, so each batch runs the network once per distinct scene and gathers; loss and gradients are unchanged (verified by test)
task_C_synthetic.selection_rule: per environment and seed, pick the frozen model with lower scene-equal calibration path MSE; evaluate on test only

budget.hardware: CPU (no CUDA device on this host)
reduction_ladder: final seeds 5 -> 3 for tasks A and C
